name: @animastor/player
description: Animastor Player — playback HTTP contour: scene media serving (Range/206/ETag/If-Range), scene data (status/storyboard/timings/waveform), IU media, playback queue and assets-state. Reads book content only through the injected playerModel (VBook boundary); every host dependency arrives as an injected port — no config, no generation, no workflows, no Redis/PG/Redis internals in the package.
